title: Chat connections
description: Use the EasySSH Agent from Telegram private chats with your existing AI settings. Conversations appear in the AI assistant.
webOnly: Manage chat connections on the web server.
emptyHelp: Create a dedicated bot, choose its allowed servers, and bind your Telegram account with a single-use link.
setupHelp: Receive private messages through Telegram Bot API long polling. No public callback URL is needed. The server must be able to reach Telegram.
name: Connection name
keepToken: Leave blank to keep the current token
tokenHelp: Credentials are encrypted and never returned to the browser. Create a dedicated bot with Telegram BotFather.
serversHelp: Only the selected servers are accessible, up to 100. Bound accounts inherit this scope.
noServers: Add a server in the console first.
editStopsWork: Saving configuration stops existing tasks and invalidates pending approval buttons.
deleteConfirm: Deleting this connection stops its tasks and removes bindings and delivery records. Agent conversation history is retained.
bindingHelp: Links expire in 10 minutes and can only be used once. Creating a new link invalidates the previous one. Anyone holding this link can obtain the configured server permissions. Use it only in your own private bot chat.
codeExpired: This binding code has expired. Create a new one.
revokeConfirm: Revoking this account stops its tasks, invalidates unused approvals, and discards pending replies to this account.

modeHelp.readonly: Read server information, monitoring data and files. Shell commands and write operations are disabled.
modeHelp.balanced: Queries are allowed. Commands and file changes use the existing Agent approval flow.
